title: Google DeepMind Launches VaultGemma: Differentially Private Open Model
author: Modelverse Editorial
excerpt: Google DeepMind has released VaultGemma 1B, a lightweight open model trained from scratch using differential privacy to mathematically prevent training data leakage.
body: VaultGemma is a new suite of models from Google DeepMind designed to prioritize differential privacy and secure data processing. By training with strict DP-SGD boundaries, VaultGemma prevents sensitive training data from leaking through model outputs or reconstruction attacks. This suite is particularly suited for enterprises working under strict compliance guidelines in finance, healthcare, and public services. It enables secure model training on proprietary data while guaranteeing that individual records cannot be reconstructed by malicious queries. This step is crucial for privacy-centric AI deployments.
